name: Amakase Minatsu
source:
Likes: Animals, electronic devices
Dislikes: Bananas, humans

Minatsu is an android developed by Professor Amakase. In Japanese "mi+natsu" means "beautiful summer". Since the creation of a humanoid robot has caused great scandal in the ranks of citizens and public organizations, professor decided to put Minatsu into hibernation, hoping that people of the future will be more tolerant regarding to the robots. And one day she was accidentally awakened by [url=/c4059]Yoshiyuki[/url]. Remembering past troubles, she held her anger towards the mankind, thinking that people have made the slaves of the robots. However, what's done is done. As a person responsible for waking Minatsu up, Yoshiyuki was entrusted with a mission to keep an eye on her while she tries to communicate with people as a student of the Kazami School. And of course, nobody should know about the fact that she is a robot. Can Yoshiyuki convince her that not all the people are so bad? Is it possible to build a bridge between humans and robots?
